# Gross pay isn’t take-home pay.

> Free calculator for DoorDash, Uber Eats, Instacart, Uber, and Lyft drivers: turn one session's gross pay into real net pay per hour and per mile after gas, maintenance, and insurance, plus a tax set-aside.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
